rationale: C06 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. The later memorandum preserves its addressee, March annual-appeal opening, statement that the Red Cross campaign is one of three authorized agency campaigns, description of disaster and congressionally chartered military-family services, and concluding appeal to Federal employees and military personnel. The later text mainly expands and updates that same structure, including an exception for chapters participating in federated campaigns. C20 and C02 are related annual campaign memoranda but share less of the child's concrete wording and full sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: During the month of March, the American National Red Cross conducts its annual campaign for members and funds. This is one of the three campaigns authorized within the Executive Departments and Agencies.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The American Red Cross makes its annual appeal for funds in the month of March. This is one of the three campaigns authorized to be conducted within Executive Departments and Agencies.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim opening that combines campaign timing with its status under the Federal fundraising system.

shared_material.child_excerpt: By Congressional Charter, the Red Cross is required to provide welfare services to members of the Armed Forces and their families at home and overseas. It maintains a program of Disaster Preparedness and Relief.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: During the year it responds to emergency calls for help from communities stricken by natural disaster... Under charter by the Congress, it provides welfare services to the members of the Armed Forces and to their families at home and overseas.
shared_material.explanation: The child retains the same paired description of disaster relief and congressionally chartered welfare services, with closely matching language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The American people have long provided the volunteers and the funds that make this great work possible. I urge employees of the Federal Government and members of the military establishments to continue their fine record in support of the Red Cross.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Employees of the Federal Government, and members of the military establishment, have long given generous support to the Red Cross appeal for volunteers and funds. I hope you will encourage this fine tradition during the coming campaign in March.
shared_material.explanation: The conclusion reworks the same components—Federal employees, military personnel, longstanding support, volunteers and funds, and encouragement to continue the tradition.
